en:
Th-There's no way I'd ever be excited to
see a magic show!

Watching that little runt perform on stage
will for sure bore the shit outta me!

<CLT=cltMIND>She still looks kind of excited, though...
Should I hang out with Miu for a while?

Like I said, it doesn't excite me! I just wanna
watch it so I can get it over with!

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time with Miu, who was
fidgeting constantly, eager for the show.

<CLT=cltMIND>I somehow ended up growing
a little closer to Miu...
